[1] warranty.md > Out of warranty
## Out of warranty

Products outside their warranty period, and declined claims, can be repaired by the Repair Center
for a fee. The customer is quoted before any work is done and can decline the quote, in which
case the product is returned at the customer's shipping cost. The bench fee of $25.00 pays for
the inspection and the quote, and is charged whether or not the customer goes ahead with the
repair. The Repair Center's own manual
describes the fee schedule and the shop procedures.

[2] repair-manual.pdf p.1
Each ticket gets a coloured tag tied to the bail or handle:
Red tag: warranty repair. The claim already has a WC- number from Customer Service.
No charge to the customer, and the return shipping is on us.
Yellow tag: paid repair. The customer has agreed to the bench fee and to an estimate
for parts.
Green tag: Second Light refurbishment. These are returns and trade-ins being rebuilt
for the refurbished shelf. There is no customer waiting, so they are worked after red
and yellow tags.
The bench fee for a paid repair is $25.00 plus parts at the catalogue price of the part. The fee
is waived under warranty. If a yellow-tag repair turns out to need parts beyond the estimate
by more than $10, stop and have Customer Service call the customer before you continue. Do
not guess at what the customer would want.

[3] repair-manual.pdf p.3
The Northstar is our most repaired product by a wide margin, which is a function of how
many we sell and of how it is used, not of any weakness. Nearly every Northstar fault is one
of four things: a clogged generator, a dry pump cup, a torn mantle, or the wrong fuel. Ask
about the fuel first. The Northstar burns Clearburn white gas or unleaded gasoline. It does
not burn kerosene, and a tank that has had kerosene in it will have a varnished generator
and a sticky check valve. That is a paid repair even inside the warranty period.
Tools for the Northstar bench: 11 mm and 13 mm open-ended wrenches, the generator
wrench (part T-ND2, the thin 9 mm one with the bent handle), a small flat screwdriver, the
pump cup oil bottle, a nylon brush, and the torque driver set to 2.5 N·m for checking.
Generator tube replacement
The generator (part G-GEN2) is the tube that runs up through the burner and carries fuel
from the tank to the mantles. Signs of a bad generator are a weak yellow flame that will not
steady, pulsing light, and a tank that holds pressure but will not deliver it. The part is
$13.00, so a typical generator replacement on a yellow tag comes to $38.00 with the bench
fee.

[4] customer-service-playbook.md > Scenario 2: a Sentinel 1000 Pro that stopped charging
### Scenario 2: a Sentinel 1000 Pro that stopped charging

On Thursday, September 3, 2026, a customer calls about a Sentinel 1000 Pro bought on June 14,
2025, order LS-2025-002210. It no longer charges from the wall or the solar top. The lantern is
inside its 5-year warranty, but the battery pack is inside its own 1-year battery warranty only
until June 14, 2026, which has passed. The agent opens warranty claim WC-030517 anyway, because
the fault may be the charging circuit rather than the pack, and explains that the Repair Center
will decide within 5 business days. On September 8 Walt Brannigan's team finds a failed charge
controller, which is a manufacturing defect covered by the 5-year warranty, and repairs it at no
charge under repair ticket RT-20931. The lantern ships back on September 11. Had the fault been
the pack alone, the agent would have quoted a paid pack replacement instead.

[5] returns-policy.md > Restocking fee
## Restocking fee

A restocking fee of 12% of the item price applies to any opened, non-defective item. "Opened"
means the factory seal or shrink wrap has been broken, or the item has been removed from its
inner packaging. An item returned in an unopened, sealed box carries no fee.

The fee is waived when:

- The return is an exchange for another item of equal or greater value.
- The item is defective, as confirmed by customer service or the Repair Center.
- The wrong item was shipped, or the item does not match its product page.
- The customer is a Beacon-tier Lumen Rewards member and the return is their first of the
  calendar year.

The fee is calculated on the price paid after discounts and before tax and shipping. On a Beacon
600 (LS-600) bought at $79.99, the fee is $9.60. On a Sentinel 1000 Pro (LS-1000P) at $219.99,
the fee is $26.40. The fee is never charged on a showroom return made within 7 days of purchase
with the receipt.
